text:
Hannah Li: Quick thread — billing card expiry indicator on the billing card widget. Current tooltip: 'Card expires soon. Update payment to avoid disruption.' Want softer tone and clear CTA.
Jordan Park: Short + action-oriented works. Maybe: 'Card expiring in 7 days — update payment method.'
Priya Iyer: Marketing suggests benefit-first: 'Keep billing uninterrupted — update your card.'
Marcus Lee: Dev constraints: tooltip width truncates at 90 chars; mobile stacks CTA under text. Need i18n key placeholders like {{days}}. Also prefer a visible secondary action 'Remind me' for later.
Olga Kuznetsova: Accessibility: tooltip should be reachable by keyboard and the CTA must have an accessible name that explains destination: 'Update card, opens payment settings'. Use aria-describedby for extra context, not the tooltip text itself.
Jordan Park: Candidate variants:
- Short: "Card expires in {{days}} — Update payment method" (CTA: 'Update card')
- Friendly: "Keep billing uninterrupted — update your card before it expires" (CTA: 'Update card')
- Soft nudge: "Your card will expire soon. Update now or set a reminder." (CTAs: 'Update card' / 'Remind me')
Priya Iyer: Prefer Friendly for emails and banners, Short for tooltips. Use 'Update card' CTA (clear when read out of context).
Marcus Lee: I'll implement mobile fallback to hide secondary 'Remind me' link and expose it in the expanded billing drawer. Also will pass full aria-label from i18n key `billing.card_expiry.cta.aria` instead of visible text.
Olga Kuznetsova: For screen readers, avoid auto-toast announcements when the expiry date changes. Use polite announcements only on load. If status flips to expired, use assertive and update role=alert.
Hannah Li: Final decision: A/B Short vs Soft nudge in the tooltip. CTA stays 'Update card' and include hidden aria text 'opens payment settings' pulled from i18n. Marcus, please add i18n keys and mobile fallbacks. I'll add copy to the PR and loop in finance for wording approval.
copy-bot: Saved variants: billing.card_expiry.short, billing.card_expiry.friendly, billing.card_expiry.soft_nudge.
